query: query($id: ID!, $criteria: WidgetCriteria!, $take: Int) { dishesByWidget(id:$id, criteria:$criteria, take:$take) { count data { dish { id name size servingSize servingSizeInGrams nutrients { caloriesTotal fatTotal carbohydrates protein } category {name} } variants { dish { id name size servingSize servingSizeInGrams nutrients { caloriesTotal fatTotal carbohydrates protein } } } cursor } } }
